name: comp-312
blurb: Version update banner with version number, description, and update button.
description: Muted background banner showing version number, feature description, and Update now button. Button shows loading spinner via useState during simulated download.
use_when: You need to prompt users to update to a new version with status feedback.
avoid_when: For required updates; use a modal or more intrusive pattern instead.
a11y: Button is keyboard accessible. Download icon has aria-hidden. Spinner animates on loading state.
